authority_rule: Provider data is reference/evidence only. Product journeys and canonical domain invariants own schema decisions.

operational_constraints: Default public API usage must remain at or below one request per second unless separately agreed.
Commercial usage terms must be reviewed separately from non-commercial access.
musicbrainz.canonical_use: Strong identity/relationship evidence; MBID remains an external identifier and never canonical primary identity.

operational_constraints: Artwork is indexed by MusicBrainz identity.
Image usage rights remain the consumer's responsibility.
Artwork availability is optional and must not define canonical release identity.
cover-art-archive.canonical_use: Presentation/media evidence associated with canonical release or release-group identities through governed external identifiers.

operational_constraints: WDQS is suited to graph queries, not fuzzy/text search.
Large-scale extraction should not be modeled as interactive WDQS reads.
Statement provenance/rank may vary and must remain evidence rather than overwrite authority.
wikidata.canonical_use: Optional enrichment and cross-identifier evidence; Wikidata QIDs remain external identifiers.

operational_constraints: Embeddability is mutable and must be revalidated for playback surfaces.
Video/channel identifiers are destination identity, not canonical music identity.
youtube.canonical_use: Listening/watching destination evidence attached to canonical entities through provider-destination records.

canonical_identity.rule: External identifiers bridge evidence to canonical entities but never replace SongChart ULID/slug identity.

credits_relationships.rule: Normalize into provider-neutral relationship/credit semantics with source/provenance retained.

artwork_media.rule: Media/artwork/destinations are projectable evidence with availability/status, not required canonical core fields.

release_hierarchy.rule: Keep logical release-group identity distinct from concrete release/edition identity.
